limitations: Posthoc exploratory extraction audit, not a preregistered solid-tumor benchmark.
Repeated title keys are not confirmed duplicate patients or independent arms.
Purposive source cases do not estimate discrepancy prevalence.
Four-category sum is reconstructed, not automatically posted analysis denominator.
No unique-patient count, pooled response or efficacy inference.
